thread:
Marta (partnerships): Short sync - want a lightweight SI co-sell handoff that covers claim windows, account mapping for marketplace + HW bundles, and announcement gating. Keep replies short.
Ethan (sales): Need predictable handoff. Sales suggests: SI gets a 48h soft-claim; if they upload LOA or set exclusive_demo then exclusive for 5 days. After soft-claim expires, assign to AE.
Sofia (solutions): Agree. Also add a pre_demo_tag so solutions can reserve an engineer slot and suppress AE outreach while pre-demo is active. Pre_demo must include expires_at and timezone.
Ben (marketplace): Marketplace integration notes: require marketplace_offer_id and hw_bundle_code for private offers. Exports must include credited_partner_id and marketplace_origin boolean for SFDC mapping.
Lynn (legal): Legal: LOA + Announcement Addendum templates OK. Recommend partner signoff window for announcements = 4 business days. LOAs to be stored (signed) and linked from intake.
Marta (partnerships): Draft intake webhook fields: partner_id, pre_demo, loa_url, claimed_until, marketplace_offer_id, hw_bundle_code, source_region. Example payload: 
```json
{
  "lead_id": "L-2024-7710",
  "account": "Cedar Systems",
  "partner_id": "si-aurora",
  "pre_demo": true,
  "loa_url": "https://s3.redwood/loas/7710.pdf",
  "claimed_until": "2024-09-01T12:00:00Z",
  "marketplace_offer_id": "aws-pvt-3344",
  "hw_bundle_code": "INTEL-AI-BUNDLE-2",
  "source_region": "NA"
}
```
Sofia (solutions): Conflict resolution: priority = (valid LOA) > (pre_demo true & earlier claim_ts) > (partner_tier). Surface conflict to #partnerships with links and quick action buttons (take, release, escalate).
Ethan (sales): Attribution: marketplace-origin deals should set sf_origin = marketplace_offer_id and credited_ae = assigned_ae. If AE unclaims within 24h after assignment, revert to partnerships queue. Also: deals >= $350k auto-escalate to Sales Ops + Partnerships.
Ben (marketplace): We'll add marketplace_offer_id, hw_bundle_code, and credited_partner_id to daily export. ETA 4 business days. We'll also add marketplace_origin boolean.
Lynn (legal): I'll post LOA and Announcement Addendum drafts to partnership drive. We should require partner logo usage rights in the addendum.
intake-bot: Note: intake schema PR opened. New optional fields accepted in webhook. See PR: https://github.com/redwood/integrations/pull/512
Marta (partnerships): Action items: Sofia to PR conflict logic, Ben to update exports, Ethan to propose SFDC field names, Lynn to post legal templates. I'll assemble a 1-page playbook and schedule a 20-min review Friday 10am PT.
Ethan (sales): 10am PT works for me.
Sofia (solutions): See you then.
Marta (partnerships): Thanks team - I'll drop the playbook link before EOD.
